name: CONNIPTION: Paranoia
detailed_description:
A young demon hunter tracks down a missing person and a violent demonic cult to a secluded coastal ghost town with a dark past, surrounded by cliffs, mountains, and dense forests, hunted by those lurking in the mist.

In this melee-focused action survival horror experience, master visceral melee combat, gather resources, craft utilities, explore the dark foggy town and its surroundings, and face the consequences of its past in a desperate struggle for survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (version 20H2 or newer)
  • Processor: 8 Hardware Threads; SSE4.2 Support [AMD Ryzen 5 3600]
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Hardware Raytracing; 8GB Video RAM; Shader Model 6.6 [RTX 2060 SUPER | AMD RX 6600]
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p | 60fps | TSR Native AA
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple M3 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Hardware Ray Tracing; Metal 3.0
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires more system memory due to sharing it between rendering and application resources.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux Kernel 6.10
  • Processor: Quad-Core; AVX-2 instruction set
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Hardware Ray Tracing; Vulkan 1.3; 6GB VRAM
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated graphics may work but are not officially supported.
